# Buffer view

Shows a geometry buffer instead of the image: distance from the camera, view-space normals from the prepass or reconstructed from depth, world position, or the mask given to this effect. Set the renderer to no tone mapping to see exact values.

<EffectDemo effect="buffer-view" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bufferView } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/buffer-view';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bufferView({ preset: 'normals' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.buffer = 'depth'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                                                                 | Default   | Range     | Description                                                                |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `buffer` _(structural)_ | 'depth' \| 'normal' \| 'reconstructedNormal' \| 'position' \| 'mask' | `'depth'` |           | What to show. Only the buffer shown is rendered.                           |
| `range`                 | number                                                               | `20`      | 0.5 – 200 | Depth: distance shown as white. Position: size of a grid cell is one unit. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- |
| `normals`   | `buffer: 'normal'`              |
| `fromDepth` | `buffer: 'reconstructedNormal'` |
| `position`  | `buffer: 'position'`            |

Apply one with `bufferView({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Utilities · tracked as story X1.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Geometry buffers:** depend on its settings; with the defaults it reads depth.
- **Masks:** reads its `mask` itself rather than fading by it (see the description); any [mask kind](/guide/masks) works.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/buffer-view`, including the shared effect runtime.

### Debugging

Add it last in the stack to see what depth, normal and mask effects read. The `mask` view shows this effect's own mask, so give it the same mask as the effect you are checking:

```ts
composer.add(bufferView({ buffer: 'mask', mask: outlineEffect.mask }));
```

The output stage still applies the renderer's tone mapping; set `renderer.toneMapping = NoToneMapping` to read exact values.
